channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: UK Disability Benefits Review Rejects Stricter Rules Amid Rising Costs
item.description: A review into the United Kingdom's disability benefits system has decided against implementing tougher rules, despite acknowledging soaring costs. The review's findings indicate a rejection of stricter eligibility criteria, opting instead… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The UK tech industry, represented by trade body techUK, has expressed frustration with the regulations surrounding the social media ban for under-16s. They argue the process has been chaotic, involving efforts to "chase children around the… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Russia to build ferries to Kaliningrad amid transport blockade concerns
item.description: Russia plans to construct rail ferries to ensure supplies to its Kaliningrad exclave, a move aimed at circumventing what it describes as a transport blockade. The Russian government has allocated $576 million for this project. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Andy Burnham stated his approach to the European Union is pragmatic, asserting that predecessors urging against reopening the Brexit debate are "stuck in the past." He also suggested that undogmatic consensus building is a sensible… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Donald Trump's political focus is reportedly shifting towards foreign policy matters, while simultaneously, the Supreme Court is considering a border case that could have significant implications beyond immigration, potentially impacting… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Singapore Prime Minister Wong stated that the country is not a "backdoor" for US chips, particularly those intended for artificial intelligence (AI) applications. This statement comes amid reports that Singapore is working with the US on… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: North Korea Threatens to Close Swiss Diplomatic Office
item.description: North Korea has threatened to close its Swiss diplomatic office in response to sanctions imposed on a Russian youth camp. The specific sanctions and the camp's name were not detailed in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: SEC Considers Expelling LSU Amid Conference Dispute
item.description: The Southeastern Conference (SEC) is planning a meeting on December 3 to decide whether to expel Louisiana State University (LSU) as a conference member. This action follows LSU's "rebellion" which has put the future of the conference at… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Senator Warren Urges Export Control Bills After Huang's Return
item.description: US Senator Elizabeth Warren has stated that the return of an individual identified as Huang has increased the urgency for export control bills. She is demanding answers from the Trump administration regarding this matter. Congress has also… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Xi, Putin, and Trump Hold Unprecedented Three-Way Talks
item.description: Leaders Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Donald Trump participated in an unprecedented three-way meeting. The summit, which took place in Shenzhen, highlighted a shared hostility towards the liberal international order. However, the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Nepal PM Balendra Shah Concludes Two-Day Visit to India
item.description: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah has concluded a two-day state visit to India, returning to Kathmandu. The visit aimed to strengthen cooperation between the two nations. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Bengal CM Vows Stricter Cow Slaughter Law, Aid for Goshalas
item.description: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has announced plans for a stricter law on cow slaughter and pledged ₹1 lakh in aid for the state's goshalas (cow shelters). The announcement follows a commitment to end illegal slaughter of 'gau… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: India and Nepal Sign New Vision Document, Announce Development Projects
item.description: India and Nepal have initiated a reset in their bilateral relations with the signing of a new vision document. This agreement includes a development push valued at Rs 15,000 crore. The renewed ties are set to focus on youth, development… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Punjab Congress Chief Asks PM to Reopen Kartarpur Corridor, Trade
item.description: Punjab Congress chief Amrinder Singh Raja Warring has urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to reopen the Kartarpur Corridor and resume trade at the Attari-Wagah border. Warring cited the spiritual significance of the Kartarpur Sahib shrine… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Azam Khan Faces Criticism Over Remarks on Beards and 'Abdullah'
item.description: AIMIM leader Waris Pathan criticized Azam Khan following his release from jail, alleging that Khan was coached before making controversial statements about beards and 'Abdullah'. Pathan referenced Bihar, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Uttarakhand Govt Announces Financial Aid for Rural Women
item.description: The Uttarakhand government, under Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami, is launching the 'Baini-Bhuli Yojana' to provide financial assistance to rural women. Under this scheme, 5.23 lakh women associated with self-help groups will receive a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Karnataka Minister Shivakumar Explores Japan's Waste Management Model
item.description: Karnataka Minister DK Shivakumar visited Osaka's Maishima plant in Japan to study the region's waste management model. During his visit, Shivakumar reportedly called protesting ASHA workers, urging them to call off their stir. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Nepal PM Balen Shah Visits India, Receives $1.6 Billion Aid Package
item.description: Nepal's Prime Minister Balen Shah concluded his first visit to India, during which India announced a $1.6 billion aid package for Nepal. The two countries signed eight Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) spanning sectors including space… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Congress Criticizes Jewar Airport Renaming, Cites Nehru's Example
item.description: The Congress party has criticized the renaming of Jewar Airport after Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Party leader Jairam Ramesh questioned the decision, drawing a parallel to former Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru's refusal to have… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump highlights Vance and Rubio amid 2028 presidential race speculation
item.description: Former U.S. President Donald Trump publicly praised Senators JD Vance and Marco Rubio, keeping them in the spotlight as speculation about the 2028 Republican presidential primary continues. Trump stated that both Vance and Rubio are "doing… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: West Bengal to be renamed Paschim Banga, cabinet approves
item.description: The West Bengal cabinet has approved a proposal to rename the state "Paschim Banga". The proposal is expected to be presented in the state assembly soon. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari made the announcement. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 2.

item.title: BJP Leader Responds to Rahul Gandhi's 'Vote Theft' Allegations
item.description: BJP leader Nitin Naveen responded to allegations of 'vote theft' made by Rahul Gandhi, stating that the public and their votes are with the BJP. Naveen asserted that Gandhi should keep his 'theft' to himself and accused Gandhi of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Government Employee Salary Hike Under 8th Pay Commission Proposed
item.description: Proposals for revising central government employee salaries under the 8th Pay Commission are being considered, with potential changes to basic pay based on proposed fitment factors. Employee unions have suggested multipliers of 3.61… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Parliament's Monsoon Session Remains Open After 100 Days
item.description: Parliament's Monsoon Session has remained open for a record 101 days, exceeding 100 days since its adjournment sine die. This extended duration is the longest in the history of Parliament. Speculation exists regarding a delimitation bill… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.title: Akhilesh Yadav's Facebook Account Briefly Suspended
item.description: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav's Facebook account was temporarily suspended, making his page with over 9 million followers unavailable for approximately 90 minutes. The suspension caused concern among his supporters. The reason for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump makes claims about US control and Somali community
item.description: Donald Trump claimed the United States has "total control" over the Strait of Hormuz. In a separate statement, he also claimed that the Somali community has "completely taken over" Minnesota. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bengal Announces Monthly Allowance for Unemployed Graduates
item.description: The government of West Bengal has announced a monthly allowance of Rs 2,000 for unemployed graduates, set to begin in January. This initiative aims to support unemployed graduates in the state. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Macron Proposes Constitutional 'Golden Rule' for French Budget
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron has proposed enshrining a 'golden rule' for the national budget within the constitution. This constitutional reform aims to cap government spending and control future deficits. The proposal echoes… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: New York Lawmaker Proposes Bill to Regulate Prediction Markets
item.description: A New York lawmaker has proposed a bill to regulate and tax prediction markets. These markets are described not as games of chance, but as investments based on specific knowledge of potential outcomes. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Republicans Debate Party's Future After Midterm Losses
item.description: Following midterm election losses, Republicans are engaged in internal discussions about the future direction of the party. These debates come after the Republican party's performance in the midterms, with the coverage indicating a period… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Indonesian President Names Vice President Candidates to Parliament
item.description: Indonesian President Joko Widodo has submitted the names of two vice presidential candidates to parliament. The candidates are intended to replace Gibran Rakabuming Raka, who is currently running for president. The specific names of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Belgium Faces Transport Chaos Amid Anti-Austerity Strike
item.description: A national strike against planned austerity measures has caused widespread transport disruption across Belgium. The government's future is reportedly in question following the strike. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ex-Mossad Chief Warns of Iran War, Netanyahu Pushes for Strikes
item.description: Former Mossad chief David Barnea has stated that Israel must prepare for another war with Iran, suggesting that a deal with Tehran would not be sustainable. Caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is reportedly seeking US backing for… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Quebec court rules legislators must swear oath to King
item.description: A Quebec court has ruled that provincial legislators must swear an oath to King Charles III. The court suspended a law that had made it optional for them to do so. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Bihar CM Vacates Seat for Opposition Leader in Assembly
item.description: During the oath-taking ceremony of newly elected members in the Bihar Legislative Council, Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhary had Minister Ramkripal Yadav vacate his seat for opposition leader Tejashwi Yadav. Tejashwi Yadav was then called to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Jay Clayton Appointed Interim National Cyber Director
item.description: Jay Clayton, identified as an intelligence leader and former Trump appointee, has been appointed to serve as the interim national cyber director. This appointment places him in a key role overseeing national cybersecurity efforts. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump Criticizes Schumer Amid US Senate Leadership Speculation
item.description: Former US President Donald Trump has criticized Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, suggesting difficulties if Schumer continues in a leadership role. The coverage does not specify the exact nature of Trump's criticism or the context of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: FIFA President's 96-Year World Cup Sale Plan Revealed
item.description: Leaked documents reportedly reveal a 96-year plan proposed by FIFA President Gianni Infantino for the sale of World Cup rights. The plan was detailed in documents obtained by The New York Times and reported by the Irish Independent. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US military memo restricts soldier interaction with Canadians
item.description: A memo reportedly circulated by US official David Hegseth last week restricts American soldiers from socializing with their Canadian counterparts without permission. One Canadian official described the memo as 'a slap in the face.' Despite… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: UK, US Democrat Criticize SpaceX Ukraine Restrictions
item.description: Britain stated that restrictions imposed by SpaceX in Ukraine have "dented confidence and trust." Separately, a US Democrat has threatened to block funding for SpaceX, citing concerns over the slowdown of Ukraine's Starshield program. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
